prompts.down: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE transparent production character animation sprite sheet based on the attached original character-design reference. The reference is identity/style guidance only, do not include its label, white background, ground dust, giant action arcs or other UI. Character: Crimson Shadow Assassin, an adult male ninja with black fitted hood and black face mask exposing only narrow intense eyes, black layered lightweight leather armor with charcoal shoulder plates, crimson piping, forearm wraps and waist ties, a LONG vivid crimson scarf with two trailing fabric ends, black trousers, knee guards and black boots. EXACTLY TWO short curved red-steel daggers, ONE firmly held in EACH hand, blades remain visible in every frame, no extra swords, no shield, no duplicates or extra limbs. Original detailed dark-fantasy game sprite with sharp hand-painted pixel-like contour, shaded material and readable silhouette, consistent elevated RPG camera and body proportions; match reference's black/crimson identity. ALL12 figures face SOUTH/toward viewer, elevated three-quarter FRONT view, eyes and chest visible. Layout EXACTLY FOUR columns by THREE rows, 12 separate full-body poses. Row1: four genuinely different walk-cycle poses (left step, passing, right step, opposite passing), with scarf sway. Row2: four sequential dual-dagger attack poses (low ready/windup, lift blades, crossing slash, recovery) and restrained thin red energy trails close to blades. Row3 first2: two distinct CAST/energy-channeling poses still holding BOTH daggers, small crimson aura close to hands. Row3 last2: two distinct HIT/recoil and recovery poses still holding BOTH daggers. Entire figure AND both blades AND scarf tips fit within central72% of EACH cell, with ample transparent margins, same body size and foot baseline. Landscape1536x1024, truly transparent RGBA background; NO checkerboard, NO background haze, NO scenery, NO ground/shadow/dust, NO grid, NO labels, NO lettering/numbers/logos/watermark. Exactly12 figures, never crossing cell boundaries.
